name: SWaT: Secure Water Treatment Testbed Dataset
description: The SWaT (Secure Water Treatment) dataset is an industrial cybersecurity and anomaly detection benchmark collected from a fully operational, six-stage water treatment testbed by iTrust at SUTD. Spanning 11 continuous days of operation (7 days normal, 4 days under 36 systematic cyber and physical attacks) recorded at 1-second intervals, it tracks continuous readings across 51 sensors and actuators along with network traffic, serving as a standard benchmark for industrial control system (ICS) defense.
